_doc: Hand-kept overlay on sclang-reference.json and sclang-wire.json for stac's generated UGen words. scripts/gen_ugens.py joins them into src/engine/SpecUGens.inc. See docs/dev/stac.md, UGens.
groups: the help categories each namespace takes, by a class's first category. The empty name is the bare words, which stay in ug only until phase 5. Only the groups listed here are generated.
place: classes put in a group by hand, over their category.
hidden: classes the compiler emits and no one types.
skip: classes not generated yet, with the reason.
tail: argument names a positional call omits when they trail.

classes.wire: input order, only where sclang-wire.json has no trusted order. 'name' sends the argument; '*name' splices its list; '#name' sends its list's size; '*a/b' splices a's list padded or cut to b's size; '*a~b' splices a's list wrapped to b's value, as LocalIn's default.wrapExtend(numChannels); '&name' sends an Env as SC's Env.asArray, '&&name' as asArrayForInterpolation; '%name' interleaves the rows of name's list, as sclang's flop.flat, filling missing rows from classes.fill.

classes.outputs: '#name' when the output count is the size of an argument's list; '=name' when it is the value of an argument that is also sent (MFCC); 'name' when it is the value of an argument that is not sent.
classes.positional: overrides the tail rule's argument count.
classes.unsent: arguments sclang applies after the UGen, as LinXFade2 multiplies by level; stac drops them, as it drops mul and add.
classes.defaults: numeric defaults where sclang's are expressions or symbols.

DecodeB2._note: sclang's DecodeB2 writes `orientation = 0.5` inside its multiNew call, so it always sends 0.5. stac sends the argument.

Onsets._note: sclang's default is \\rcomplex, index 3 of [power magsum complex rcomplex phase wphase mkl]
